description: This PHP source file defines the ReviewKpiSearchFilterParams class within the OrangeHRMPerformanceDto namespace. It extends the FilterParams class and is used to specify filter parameters for searching KPIs related to performance reviews, including properties for review ID and reviewer group name, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ReviewKpiSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object class for filtering KPI search results in performance reviews, allowing filtering by review ID and reviewer group name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the search filter with the default sort field 'kpi.title'.

methods.name: getReviewId
methods.description: Returns the review ID used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setReviewId
methods.description: Sets the review ID used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: getReviewerGroupName
methods.description: Returns the reviewer group name used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setReviewerGroupName
methods.description: Sets the reviewer group name used as a filter criterion.
